equips.TUTORIAL_ENHANCE_GEAR_01: You came to enhance your gear! You can enhance your gear by using other gear for Enhancement Materials!
equips.TUTORIAL_ENHANCE_GEAR_02: Now, shall we try enhancing some gear? Select some gear to use as Enhancement Materials!
equips.TUTORIAL_ENHANCE_GEAR_03: You can use up to 5 Enhancement Materials at a time! Shall we start enhancing the gear?
equips.TUTORIAL_ENHANCE_GEAR_04: Nice! Your gear is now enhanced! Collect more gear and enhance your gear to +5!
equips.TUTORIAL_EQUIP_GEAR_00: Here you can equip gear to make your Ranger stronger! First, select a Ranger to equip gear on!
equips.TUTORIAL_EQUIP_GEAR_01: Gear is composed of 3 slots: Weapon, Armor, and Accessory. You can equip the right gear for your Ranger type!
equips.TUTORIAL_EQUIP_GEAR_02: Tap your gear to see its details! Try it now!
equips.TUTORIAL_EQUIP_GEAR_03: If you tap the Equip button on the gear details screen, it will be equipped! Now, let's tap the Equip button!
equips.TUTORIAL_EQUIP_GEAR_04: Good job! The gear boosted your Ranger's STATS! You can change gear. So collect as much gear as you can create the most powerful Rangers!
equips.TUTORIAL_GEAR_SPECIAL_OPTION_1: 9-Star Gear will get specialized option enhancements that will let you specialize your Rangers' roles!
equips.TUTORIAL_GEAR_SPECIAL_OPTION_2: You can enhance the stats of specialized options for 9-Star Gear.
equips.TUTORIAL_GEAR_SPECIAL_OPTION_3: To enhance specialized options, you need both materials and a certain number of Coins.
equips.TUTORIAL_GEAR_SPECIAL_OPTION_4: Make good use of specialized options to enhance the roles of your Rangers!

abilities.STAGE_GIMMICK_HELLFIRE_DESC: Meteors fall on Rangers, dealing damage. Rangers hit by meteors have a fixed chance of floating up into the air.

properties.BALANCE_ABOUT_EVENT_BINGO_TICKET_RANDOM: Use Random Tickets to randomly unlock numbers on the 5x5 grid. Spaces that have already been unlocked may get selected again. Get Random Tickets from missions.
properties.BALANCE_ABOUT_EVENT_BINGO_TICKET_SELECT: You can use up Select Tickets to choose spaces you haven't gotten yet and get their rewards. You'll get Select Tickets depending on how many times spaces have been repeatedly selected in the draw.
properties.BALANCE_ABOUT_EVENT_LOTTERY_COIN: You can get Wish Hammers via Missions, etc. You can only use Hammers obtained during the collection period in the Shooting Star Raffle. When the event ends, any leftover Hammers will be lost.
properties.BALANCE_ABOUT_EVENT_ROULETTE_COIN: You can get Wheel Event Coins by clearing missions. They can only be acquired and used during the event period, and any remaining Coins will be lost when the event ends.
properties.BALANCE_ABOUT_GACHA_MILEAGE: You'll get Mileage Points based on the amounts of Rubies and Gacha Tickets you use on the Ultra Rare, Special Gear, Selection, and Rare Gachas.
properties.BALANCE_ABOUT_GUILD_COIN: Guild Coins are a commodity guilds can get. The Guildmaster and Submaster can exchange them at the Contribution Swap Shop.
properties.BALANCE_ABOUT_GUILD_CONTRIBUTION_POINT: Contribution is a commodity each guild member can get. It can be exchanged at the Contribution Swap Shop.
properties.BALANCE_ABOUT_GUILD_EVENT_MATERIAL: Obtainable through missions, this can be used to purchase items from the Event Exchange Shop. Exchange unused items for Crystals in the Crystal Extraction Lab of Leonard's Lab after the event ends.
properties.BALANCE_ABOUT_GUILD_RAID_COIN: Guild Gems can only be acquired from Guild raids. You can use them in the Guild Shop.
properties.BALANCE_ABOUT_PVP_COIN: PVP Gems can only be acquired from PVP mode. You can use them in the PVP Shop.
properties.BALANCE_ABOUT_RANDOM_DICE: An item used while playing the board game. Clear missions to get them. They'll disappear when the event ends.
properties.BALANCE_ABOUT_RANGERS_PASS_POINT: Get enough Rangers Pass Points to raise your pass level! You'll get pass rewards every time your pass level goes up.
properties.BALANCE_ABOUT_SPACE_COIN: Tickets needed to play Space Train. Train Tickets recharge over time and disappear when the season ends.
properties.BALANCE_ABOUT_TALENT_PIECE: Obtainable via a special process. Use them in Leonard combinations at the Fusion Lab.

properties.POTENTIAL_TIP_DESC: Potential Levels are the total sum of all stats' Potentials. Potential level caps are as follows. 500 + the number of Rangers in collection + the number of mastered Rangers Level cap is %d.
properties.POTENTIAL_TUTORIAL_1: Oh, well done! After years of research, I've found a way to bring out new abilities in Rangers!
properties.POTENTIAL_TUTORIAL_2: I'm going to explain Potential to you now, so be sure to keep up!
properties.POTENTIAL_TUTORIAL_3: You can use level up materials to raise Rangers' Potential Levels and stats along with them. When you raise their Potential Levels, their stats will go up too.
properties.POTENTIAL_TUTORIAL_4: Tap the Level Up button to raise Potential Levels.
properties.POTENTIAL_TUTORIAL_5: The more Rangers you have in your collection, the higher you can raise their Potential Levels, so try to get as many Rangers as you can!
properties.POTENTIAL_TUTORIAL_6: You can get the Materials you need to raise Potential Levels on main stages. It would be a good idea to clear main stages regularly to have a regular supply of Materials.
properties.POTENTIAL_TUTORIAL_7: When you tap the reset button and reset a Ranger's Potential Level, you'll get back the Materials you used.
properties.POTENTIAL_TUTORIAL_8: Careful though, if you reset a Ranger's Potentials without using a Reset Potentials Item, you'll only get back some of the materials you originally used.
properties.POTENTIAL_UP_POPUP_WARNING: Materials used for leveling up will disappear.
properties.PROFILE_ADVENT_DESCRIPTION: Advent Rangers can be used as material in order to hyper evolve other Rangers.
properties.PROFILE_EXCEES_LV_HOWTO_DESCRIPTION_FOR_: Level up your Hyper Leonard or Hyper Ranger by synthesizing it with one of the same kind and its Max Level will also increase. (Up to 20 times)
properties.PROFILE_TYPE_AGI_DESC: 'Agility-type' Rangers use Critical Hit and have great Normal DEF and Dodge Chance. They can easily damage sturdy Strength-type Rangers.
properties.PROFILE_TYPE_INT_DESC: 'Intelligence-type' Rangers usually launch ranged attacks. Because they have Magic ATK, they can easily handle Agility-type Rangers without Magic DEF.
properties.PROFILE_TYPE_STR_DESC: 'Strength-type' Rangers have high HP, and also have Magic DEF and Skill Resistance. They are good at fighting Intelligence-type Rangers who mainly launch magic attacks.
properties.PVP_BATTLE_CLEAR_DESC: If you join a guild, you can get help from a Guild Guardian in battles!
properties.PVP_BLIND_POPUP_TIP: You can't see your opponent's information in blind matches, but you'll get more Trophies than usual when you win. You can change to a different opponent for free in blind matches, but then the match will no longer be counted as a blind match.

properties.PVP_ELEMENT_SEASON_DESC_TREE: An area will appear in the PVP stages where Wood Element Rangers will get buffs and non-Wood Element Rangers will get debuffs. - Buff areas for Light and Dark Element Rangers will appear randomly.
properties.PVP_ELEMENT_SEASON_DESC_WATER: An area will appear in the PVP stages where Water Element Rangers will get buffs and non-Water Element Rangers will get debuffs. - Buff areas for Light and Dark Element Rangers will appear randomly.

properties.RANDOMDICE_TUTORIAL_STEP_1: You can collect dice in missions.
properties.RANDOMDICE_TUTORIAL_STEP_10: Also, there are mystery “?” spaces; you never know which effect will be triggered.
properties.RANDOMDICE_TUTORIAL_STEP_11: Lastly, there are bonus chances where, you can get a chance to roll the dice again if you're lucky. Try your luck!

properties.SPACE_TRAIN_ENTRY_TUTOR_BOARD_DESC_1: Space Trains are runner style Battle Stages where you play by switching to Rangers suited to the current lane you're running on. A Ranger's HP is determined by their combat power, which is set by replacing their stats.
properties.SPACE_TRAIN_ENTRY_TUTOR_BOARD_DESC_2: Colliding with Star Boxes grants you points along with various rewards. Your Fever Gauge gets a certain chance of filling up from Star Boxes. When the Fever Gauge is full, Fever Time activates, making Rangers grow larger and power up for a while.
properties.SPACE_TRAIN_ENTRY_TUTOR_BOARD_DESC_3: You'll take damage if you collide with enemies. However, colliding with enemies whose elements are compatible with your Ranger can reduce the damage taken.
properties.SPACE_TRAIN_ENTRY_TUTOR_BOARD_DESC_4: You’ll take significant damage if you collide with obstacles, so be sure to avoid them.
properties.SPACE_TRAIN_ENTRY_TUTOR_BOARD_DESC_5: If a buff pad's element matches the element of the Ranger stepping on it, that Ranger will power up for a while. When you get an item, it goes into effect immediately.

properties.SPACE_TRAIN_POINT_TIP_DESC: Point totals are calculated by adding each Train's highest score. Your current rank is determined based on your total points.

properties.SPACE_TRAIN_STARTING_TIP_DESC: You can select and assign one Ranger as the starting member, deploying them at the start without using minerals. Other Rangers will appear randomly and can be swapped based on the player's selection.

properties.TRANS_INSTRUCTION_DESC: Here is how to transfer your data. To configure a transfer, select Data Transfer Settings. For guest accounts, data transfers are available for 24 hours after transfer settings have been set. Transferring data via this feature is only possible between iOS devices. Please also consider using the "Login with LINE" feature, as linking your LINE account will allow you to conveniently transfer your data simply by logging in.
properties.TRANS_SETTING_DESC_1: Your ID and password will be used to transfer your data. Transfer ID: Set an ID of your choice (5 to 10 alphanumeric characters only. Case-sensitive.) Password: Issued after ID registration Notes: - Data transfer is only possible between iOS devices. - After transferring your data, the guest account data on the original device will be deleted.
properties.TRANS_SETTING_DESC_2: Notes: - We will be unable to provide support for any issues that occur during the transfer process. Please save your ID and password in a safe place. - Your password is valid for 24 hours after registration, and you have a maximum of 10 attempts to enter your password. - After transferring your data, the guest account data on the original device will be deleted.

properties.TUTORIAL_10.6_START_BALLOON_STEP_C1_TXT: Moon, you've got lots of Mineral. Deploy more Rangers!
properties.TUTORIAL_10.6_START_BALLOON_STEP01_TXT: This is our Tower. We'll lose if its HP reaches 0, so be careful!
properties.TUTORIAL_10.6_START_BALLOON_STEP02_TXT: This is the enemies' Tower. Our goal is to destroy it and win!
properties.TUTORIAL_10.6_START_BALLOON_STEP03_TXT: These are Rangers who will deploy into the battle. You need Mineral to deploy them.
properties.TUTORIAL_10.6_START_BALLOON_STEP05_TXT: Our Mineral decreased a lot, but Mineral gradually increases with the passage of time.
properties.TUTORIAL_10.6_START_BALLOON_STEP06_TXT: Upgrading will let you get Mineral faster and store more of it.
properties.TUTORIAL_10.6_START_BALLOON_STEP07_TXT: Of course, it's not free. Upgrades cost Mineral too.
properties.TUTORIAL_10.6_START_BALLOON_STEP08_TXT: Moon! The missile finished charging. Fire it!
properties.TUTORIAL_10.6_START_BALLOON_STEP09_TXT: You can speed up missile charging by tapping the Missile button repeatedly.
properties.TUTORIAL_10.6_START_STEP01_TXT: (Huh? Where am I? I know I was walking with Sally...)
properties.TUTORIAL_10.6_START_STEP02_TXT: Moon! What are you doing! The space army is gathering!
properties.TUTORIAL_10.6_START_STEP03_TXT: Cony? Jessica? What's going on? Where's Sally?
properties.TUTORIAL_10.6_START_STEP04_TXT: What are you talking about, Moon? Our Tower's gonna break! Get it together!
properties.TUTORIAL_10.6_START_STEP05_TXT: That's Moon for you, always muttering nonsense. Cony, we'd better explain things to him again.
properties.TUTORIAL_10.6_START_STEP06_TXT: Are you kidding me? Moon! I'll tell you one last time, so listen up!
properties.TUTORIAL_10.6_START_STEP07_TXT: I'm amazed that you made it this far. But it's time we put an end to this. I'll take you on myself!
properties.TUTORIAL_10.6_START_STEP08_TXT: Moon! Cony! We're in trouble! Mephisto himself appeared!
properties.TUTORIAL_10.6_START_STEP09_TXT: Don't worry! If I remember everything you've taught me, I'll be able to handle him! Just trust me!
properties.TUTORIAL_10.6_START_STEP10_TXT: (Now, let's take out Mephisto using what we learned from Cony)
properties.TUTORIAL_10.6_START_STEP11_TXT: Such pests. But that won't be enough. I'll show you my ambition of taking over the universe!
properties.TUTORIAL_10.6_START_STEP13_TXT: Ah! It's no good. Everything's fading to black... Cony, Jessica, is this it for me? Everybody...
properties.TUTORIAL_10.6_START_STEP14_TXT: Guys! Oh, it was just a dream. It feels so real. It's like I really fought.
properties.TUTORIAL_10.6_START_STEP15_TXT: Oh yeah. I was walking with Sally, right?
properties.TUTORIAL_10.6_START_STEP16_TXT: Sally! Sally! I had a dream that felt so real.
properties.TUTORIAL_10.6_START_STEP17_TXT: Hahaha! It seems like you became a hero in your dream, eh Moon? I didn't think the special sleeping gas I created would work this well.
properties.TUTORIAL_10.6_START_STEP18_TXT: Mephisto! No! But is it really Mephisto! No! Sally? Sally!
properties.TUTORIAL_10.6_START_STEP19_TXT: I took Sally while you were catching up with your beauty sleep. Hahaha! I'll be going now! The universe belongs to me! Hahaha!
properties.TUTORIAL_10.6_START_STEP20_TXT: No! I can't believe Mephisto kidnapped Sally! But this is no time to mope about. We have to go tell Dr. Leonard what happened!
properties.TUTORIAL_10.6_START_STEP21_TXT: Arrrgh! Doctor Leonard! Something terrible's happened!
properties.TUTORIAL_10.6_START_STEP22_TXT: Oh, it's you, Moon. Your face is as white as a sheet. Calm down and tell me in detail what happened.
properties.TUTORIAL_10.6_START_STEP23_TXT: I was out walking with Sally when I suddenly had a daydream.
properties.TUTORIAL_10.6_START_STEP24_TXT: In my dream, I was a super strong Ranger. Everyone was jealous of me...
properties.TUTORIAL_10.6_START_STEP25_TXT: Alright, hold up a minute! I don't need that much detail! Just get to the "terrible" part!
properties.TUTORIAL_10.6_START_STEP26_TXT: Uh, right... It's Sally... She... An army of Aliens kidnapped her!
properties.TUTORIAL_10.6_START_STEP27_TXT: What?! That *is* terrible news! We have to go after her now!
properties.TUTORIAL_10.6_START_STEP28_TXT: Quickly, follow Mephisto to the next region!
properties.TUTORIAL_12.4_GACHA0_STEP1_TXT: Come to think of it, we'll need lots of Rangers to rescue Sally.
properties.TUTORIAL_12.4_GACHA0_STEP2_TXT: Hmm, perhaps we should take a look at the gacha screen.
properties.TUTORIAL_12.4_TEAM0_STEP1_TXT: A new friend has joined the team.
properties.TUTORIAL_12.4_TEAM0_STEP10_TXT: Well... But... I... I'm sorry! If only I was a strong, super kick-butt hero...
properties.TUTORIAL_12.4_TEAM0_STEP11_TXT: Jessica, don't blame him. Moon did the best he could!
properties.TUTORIAL_12.4_TEAM0_STEP12_TXT: Alright, I guess what's done is done. Fine, I'll come with you.
properties.TUTORIAL_12.4_TEAM0_STEP13_TXT: Alright, stow the chatter, we've got a Sally to save! Go, go, go!
properties.TUTORIAL_12.4_TEAM0_STEP15_TXT: Now that Jessica joined, let's edit our team!
properties.TUTORIAL_12.4_TEAM0_STEP6_TXT: Jessica, we need your help. Sally's been taken by an Alien army.
properties.TUTORIAL_12.4_TEAM0_STEP7_TXT: What do you mean, "Sally's been taken?"
properties.TUTORIAL_12.4_TEAM0_STEP8_TXT: When Sally and I were out walking, an Alien army appeared—
properties.TUTORIAL_12.4_TEAM0_STEP9_TXT: What?! And you just let them take her?!
properties.TUTORIAL_ARENA_BATTLE_START: This 30-on-30 brawl is about to start! Whose Rangers will see the end of battle? I have no idea, so let's find out!
properties.TUTORIAL_AUTO_BATTLE_STEP1_TXT: There's a relaxed way to battle!
properties.TUTORIAL_AUTO_BATTLE_STEP2_TXT: Toggle on AUTO with the button to use auto-battling.
properties.TUTORIAL_BATTLE_SPEED_STEP1_TXT: Once you've gotten used to battles, why not try battling faster?
properties.TUTORIAL_BATTLE_SPEED_STEP2_TXT: You can speed up battles with the speed button.
properties.TUTORIAL_BATTLE0_STEP1_TXT: First, let me explain how battles work.
properties.TUTORIAL_BATTLE0_STEP11_TXT: Well then, shall we start up for real, albeit slowly?
properties.TUTORIAL_BATTLE0_STEP12_TXT: Let's try deploying some Rangers first.
properties.TUTORIAL_BATTLE0_STEP13_TXT: Hmm, we don't have enough resources. Maybe we should try a resource upgrade.
properties.TUTORIAL_BATTLE0_STEP14_TXT: OK, that should be enough. Now try selecting a Ranger that uses up a lot of resources.
properties.TUTORIAL_BATTLE0_STEP15_TXT: Missile charged! Now, fire it off!
properties.TUTORIAL_BATTLE0_STEP16_TXT: You can speed up missile charging by tapping the Missile button repeatedly.
properties.TUTORIAL_BATTLE0_STEP17_TXT: OK, take out that enemy Tower!
properties.TUTORIAL_BATTLE0_STEP18_TXT: Great job! Alright then, now let's go rescue Sally!
properties.TUTORIAL_BATTLE0_STEP2_TXT: This is your side's Tower. Don't let its HP reach 0, or you'll lose the battle.
properties.TUTORIAL_BATTLE0_STEP3_TXT: This is the enemy's Tower. Your goal is to destroy it.
properties.TUTORIAL_BATTLE0_STEP4_TXT: These are the Rangers who'll fight for you. You can deploy them by using some Mineral.
properties.TUTORIAL_BATTLE0_STEP5_TXT: Don't forget that Mineral is at the core of everything you do in battle.
properties.TUTORIAL_BATTLE0_STEP6_TXT: Tap this button if you want to increase your Mineral total.
properties.TUTORIAL_BATTLE0_STEP7_TXT: Of course in life, you get nothing for free. Upgrades will use up some of your Mineral total.
properties.TUTORIAL_BATTLE0_STEP8_TXT: If the battle's not going well for you, you can call on the power of your Tower.
properties.TUTORIAL_BATTLE1_STEP1_TXT: Let's look for Sally in this next area.
properties.TUTORIAL_BATTLE1_STEP2_TXT: Time to try equipping some items that'll help you in battle.
properties.TUTORIAL_COMPLETE_STEP01_TXT: OK, you got all the Adventure Data. Let's make sure nothing's missing.
properties.TUTORIAL_DAILY_FREE_PACKAGE_TXT: You can get free items every day from the Package Shop.
properties.TUTORIAL_DOWN_STEP01_TXT: Wait a sec! Take this extra Adventure Data before you go!
properties.TUTORIAL_DOWN_STEP03_TXT: It's an extra device for all of you to experience new adventures!
properties.TUTORIAL_DOWN_STEP04_TXT: You just need to wait a little. Here, take it.
properties.TUTORIAL_DR_LEONARD_STEP01_TXT: Oh, so you got a Dr. Leonard!
properties.TUTORIAL_DR_LEONARD_STEP03_TXT: Well, Dr. Leonards are very helpful in raising the levels of your characters.
properties.TUTORIAL_DR_LEONARD_STEP04_TXT: Doctor, how do I use them?
properties.TUTORIAL_DR_LEONARD_STEP05_TXT: It's easy. All you have to do is combine the Ranger you want to grow with a Dr. Leonard.
properties.TUTORIAL_DR_LEONARD_STEP07_TXT: What's the difference between this and the Ranger enhancing you told me about before?
properties.TUTORIAL_DR_LEONARD_STEP08_TXT: You'll get more EXP than with normal enhancing, so you'll evolve faster.
properties.TUTORIAL_DR_LEONARD_STEP09_TXT: Wow! That's great news! Thanks, Doctor!
properties.TUTORIAL_ELEMENT_UNLOCK_STEP1: Some existing Rangers that did not have an elemental type can now have one.
properties.TUTORIAL_ELEMENT_UNLOCK_STEP2: Find Evolution Materials in Special Stages and use them to unlock Ranger Elements!
properties.TUTORIAL_END_GEAR_TEXT: Wow! You drew great gear! Tap the gear in the Ranger details window to equip your Rangers with it!
properties.TUTORIAL_EQUIP0_STEP10_TXT: Here's where you can get more Gear.
properties.TUTORIAL_EQUIP0_STEP11_TXT: Really?! Thank you so much, Doc!
properties.TUTORIAL_EQUIP0_STEP112_TXT: You can have the first Gear item!
properties.TUTORIAL_EQUIP0_STEP113_TXT: Here you are! It's all yours!
properties.TUTORIAL_EQUIP0_STEP12_TXT: Ho-ho! Nice Gear you've got there!
properties.TUTORIAL_EQUIP0_STEP13_TXT: With that said... How do we use these thingies?
properties.TUTORIAL_EQUIP0_STEP14_TXT: Hmm, let me walk you through the basics... Choose which Ranger you want to equip your Gear with.
properties.TUTORIAL_EQUIP0_STEP15_TXT: Here, you can see what Gear your Team's currently got equipped. See how all your Gear slots are empty right now?
properties.TUTORIAL_EQUIP0_STEP16_TXT: Yeah, I see. So we've been fighting barehanded up till now?
properties.TUTORIAL_EQUIP0_STEP17_TXT: Yes, you could say that. So, equip the Gear that you just got.
properties.TUTORIAL_EQUIP0_STEP18_TXT: Tell me how to do that now, Doctor!
properties.TUTORIAL_EQUIP0_STEP19_TXT: Calm down and slow your roll! Now, choose an empty Gear slot.
properties.TUTORIAL_EQUIP0_STEP2_TXT: Oh-ho! What happened here? You're all covered in dirt!
properties.TUTORIAL_EQUIP0_STEP21_TXT: I'll go through it with you step-by-step, so don't worry. This window shows you what you have equipped now.
properties.TUTORIAL_EQUIP0_STEP22_TXT: Each Ranger can equip a Weapon, an Armor, and an Accessory.
properties.TUTORIAL_EQUIP0_STEP23_TXT: And this over here is the list of Gear you guys own. Try equipping some of it now.
properties.TUTORIAL_EQUIP0_STEP24_TXT: Well done! Now that you've Geared up, you should be a bit stronger now.
properties.TUTORIAL_EQUIP0_STEP25_TXT: Okay, I think that's enough. Let's go!
properties.TUTORIAL_EQUIP0_STEP3_TXT: Hehe, this is what happened when we went off to rescue Sally.
properties.TUTORIAL_EQUIP0_STEP4_TXT: Hmm... well, you all did get ready and leave in a hurry!
properties.TUTORIAL_EQUIP0_STEP5_TXT: What do you mean by "get ready?"
properties.TUTORIAL_EQUIP0_STEP6_TXT: Oh yes, come to think of it, it's about time you equipped yourselves with some new Gear.
properties.TUTORIAL_EQUIP0_STEP7_TXT: New Gear? Awesome! Brown looks super stoked too!
properties.TUTORIAL_EQUIP0_STEP9_TXT: Come on over to the gacha.
properties.TUTORIAL_EQUIP1_STEP1_TXT: Hey Brown, what's that in your hand there?
properties.TUTORIAL_EQUIP1_STEP10_TXT: First, you have to choose the Gear item you want to enhance. Choose a Ranger, and then choose a Gear slot.
properties.TUTORIAL_EQUIP1_STEP11_TXT: So, do you want to enhance the shield you just got?
properties.TUTORIAL_EQUIP1_STEP112_TXT: Alright! Tap the ENHANCE button in the Gear info window to enhance it.
properties.TUTORIAL_EQUIP1_STEP12_TXT: You'll need to use some other Gear items as materials to enhance your chosen Gear item.
properties.TUTORIAL_EQUIP1_STEP13_TXT: So we have to use up materials here too, huh?
properties.TUTORIAL_EQUIP1_STEP14_TXT: That's right. Choose some Gear from the list on the right to use as materials.
properties.TUTORIAL_EQUIP1_STEP15_TXT: Alright, your Gear's been enhanced. Don't forget that Gear that's enhanced like this not only has its basic abilities enhanced, but its Element as well.
properties.TUTORIAL_EQUIP1_STEP16_TXT: Wow, I wish I could enhance my Gear too!
properties.TUTORIAL_EQUIP1_STEP17_TXT: There's no need to get jealous, it's easy to come by the materials you need for Gear enhancements.
properties.TUTORIAL_EQUIP1_STEP18_TXT: Well then, shall we go to the next stage?
properties.TUTORIAL_EQUIP1_STEP3_TXT: Come on Brown, show it to me!
properties.TUTORIAL_EQUIP1_STEP4_TXT: Oh, a new Gear item, eh? Considering the Gear you have now, this doesn't look like it would be very useful to you, though.
properties.TUTORIAL_EQUIP1_STEP5_TXT: Oh, I did think it was rather easy to get.
properties.TUTORIAL_EQUIP1_STEP6_TXT: Don't be so disappointed, Moon. Now's a good time to explain Gear enhancements to you.
properties.TUTORIAL_EQUIP1_STEP7_TXT: Gear enhancements? But we're already pretty well powered up...
properties.TUTORIAL_EQUIP1_STEP8_TXT: You'll like this, it's a way to make your Gear even more powerful.
properties.TUTORIAL_EQUIP1_STEP9_TXT: Wow, that sounds amazing! Tell us more!
properties.TUTORIAL_EVOLVE_SWITCH_STEP1: You can change Rangers' evolutions here! Switch evolutions as needed to make the perfect team!
properties.TUTORIAL_EVOLVE_SWITCH_STEP2: Certain evolution materials are needed to switch evolutions. Don't worry; Level, Leonard Points, and Gear are kept when you switch! Alright, let's give it a try!
properties.TUTORIAL_EXTREME_MODE_AREA_1: The new Extreme difficulty level is now unlocked for a fresh challenge! Ready to take a quick look and see what it's all about?
properties.TUTORIAL_EXTREME_MODE_AREA_2: You can clear each stage once a day. The maximum number of daily entries is shared with the existing Hard difficulty, so make sure to manage your attempts wisely!
properties.TUTORIAL_EXTREME_MODE_AREA_3: Well then, shall we jump right in and check out a stage with the new difficulty?
properties.TUTORIAL_EXTREME_MODE_ENTRY_1: Extreme difficulty stages come with different battle gimmicks unique to each stage. Checking them before heading into battle will definitely give you an edge. You can view the gimmicks here.
properties.TUTORIAL_EXTREME_MODE_ENTRY_2: If you tap on a gimmick icon, you can check its detailed information. Try experimenting with different team compositions to match each gimmick!
properties.TUTORIAL_EXTREME_MODE_START: We've picked up a new distress signal. Shall we go ahead and check it out?
properties.TUTORIAL_FRIEND_STEP11_TXT: Alright, let's call on a friend's help now. Tap the friend button above.
properties.TUTORIAL_FRIEND0_STEP10_TXT: This is where you choose which friend will help you in battle. The friend you choose can only help you once a day.
properties.TUTORIAL_FRIEND0_STEP11_TXT: Try choosing a friend now. That friend's Rangers will come to assist you in the next battle.
properties.TUTORIAL_FRIEND0_STEP12_TXT: Alright, let's call on a friend's help now. Tap the friend button above.
properties.TUTORIAL_FRIEND0_STEP14_TXT: Well done, everyone! Keep fighting the good fight against the Alien army with your friends!
properties.TUTORIAL_FRIEND0_STEP2_TXT: What happened? Did Sally come home?
properties.TUTORIAL_FRIEND0_STEP3_TXT: No, there's about as much chance of that as you growing a pink afro. The Alien army won't make things that easy, Moon!
properties.TUTORIAL_FRIEND0_STEP6_TXT: Some friends have turned up who'll help you.
properties.TUTORIAL_FRIEND0_STEP8_TXT: Let's have a look now. We'll see them in battle, so let's get into a fight!
properties.TUTORIAL_GACHA_COMPLETE: WOW!! That's some good-looking Rangers you have there. Let's go rescue Sally with other Rangers!
properties.TUTORIAL_GACHA0_STEP1_TXT: A new friend has joined the team.
properties.TUTORIAL_GACHA0_STEP11_TXT: Oh my, well aren't you looking good? You still don't have anything on me, though.
properties.TUTORIAL_GACHA0_STEP13_TXT: Jessica, we need your help. Sally's been taken by an Alien army.
properties.TUTORIAL_GACHA0_STEP14_TXT: What do you mean, "Sally's been taken?"
properties.TUTORIAL_GACHA0_STEP15_TXT: When Sally and I were out walking, an Alien army appeared—
properties.TUTORIAL_GACHA0_STEP16_TXT: What?! And you just let them take her?!
properties.TUTORIAL_GACHA0_STEP17_TXT: Well... But... I... I'm sorry! If only I was a strong, super kick-butt hero...
properties.TUTORIAL_GACHA0_STEP18_TXT: Jessica, don't blame him. Moon did the best he could!
properties.TUTORIAL_GACHA0_STEP19_TXT: Alright, I guess what's done is done. Fine, I'll come with you.
properties.TUTORIAL_GACHA0_STEP20_TXT: Alright, stow the chatter, we've got a Sally to save! Go, go, go!
properties.TUTORIAL_GACHA0_STEP22_TXT: Now that you have more Rangers, let's look at your Team again.
properties.TUTORIAL_GACHA0_STEP23_TXT: Your Team has 5 Rangers in it. Swipe to arrange your Team or remove Rangers from your Team.
properties.TUTORIAL_GACHA0_STEP24_TXT: Is there anything I should be careful of when putting my Team together?
properties.TUTORIAL_GACHA0_STEP25_TXT: Yes, there are some things you should keep in mind.
properties.TUTORIAL_GACHA0_STEP26_TXT: Each Ranger has their own Element, of which there are 5: Water, Fire, Wood, Light, and Dark.
properties.TUTORIAL_GACHA0_STEP27_TXT: Each element has their own connections to other Elements. Look at this chart to see how they interact with each other.
properties.TUTORIAL_GACHA0_STEP28_TXT: Depending on a Ranger's Element, they'll deal extra damage to the right enemies, or in turn take more damage themselves.
properties.TUTORIAL_GACHA0_STEP3_TXT: There's someone I would like to introduce you to.
properties.TUTORIAL_GACHA0_STEP5_TXT: Hmm, perhaps we should take a look at the gacha screen.
properties.TUTORIAL_GACHA0_STEP6_TXT: You need Rubies to summon friends. Use the 20 Rubies you got from me to tap the button and call up a friend!
properties.TUTORIAL_GACHA0_STEP9_TXT: Oh, it was you guys who called me here?
properties.TUTORIAL_GUILD_RAID_START: Attack Guardians with your guild members within the time limit! Defeat lots of Guardians to get good rewards!
properties.TUTORIAL_HARD_MODE_AREA: Watch out! This place is pretty creepy, huh? Right over there! Go ahead, tap!
properties.TUTORIAL_HARD_MODE_ENTRY_1: You can get a special reward the first time you get a clear on Hard difficulty, so give it all you got!
properties.TUTORIAL_HARD_MODE_ENTRY_2: Even if it's not your first clear, you can still get items you need to power up your Rangers, so be sure to play every day!
properties.TUTORIAL_HARD_MODE_ENTRY_3: Hard mode stages can only be cleared once a day each. Try again tomorrow!
properties.TUTORIAL_HARD_MODE_ENTRY_4: Too hard? Tap (?) for a handy tip!
properties.TUTORIAL_HARD_MODE_PRESS_BTN: The S.O.S. is coming from over there. It's a very dangerous place. Be careful.
properties.TUTORIAL_HARD_MODE_START: We've received a call for help! Dr. PAIMON's already been captured, so what could it be? Hurry!
properties.TUTORIAL_HYPER_EVOLVE_STEP1: Hyper Evolution is different than other evolutions in that you need Advent Rangers to achieve it.
properties.TUTORIAL_HYPER_EVOLVE_STEP2: Once you Hyper Evolve, you'll get a second Skill and a special Ability that only Hyper Rangers can possess.
properties.TUTORIAL_HYPER_EVOLVE_STEP3: Make your Rangers stronger by Hyper Evolving them to get these special Skills and Abilities!
properties.TUTORIAL_HYPER_UNIT_UPGRADE_EXCEEDMAX_2: If you combine an Hyper Ranger with Hyper Leonard, Max level will increase!
properties.TUTORIAL_ITEM_AREA: We don't know where they took Sally. Try the 'Valley of Wind' first.
properties.TUTORIAL_ITEM_MAIN: Tutorial reward Rangers Underwear Brown and Pink Ribbon Pico are getting ready for battle! Let's get down to business and enter the main stages!
properties.TUTORIAL_LEVELUP0_STEP12_TXT: Well, you can't get better looking than I already am anyway.
properties.TUTORIAL_LEVELUP0_STEP13_TXT: That's not actually what I meant...
properties.TUTORIAL_LEVELUP0_STEP14_TXT: Doctor, you don't have to respond to every pointless thing he says.
properties.TUTORIAL_LEVELUP0_STEP15_TXT: Understood. So, let's talk about powering up again. Choose a new Ranger.
properties.TUTORIAL_LEVELUP0_STEP17_TXT: In order to level up, you'll need to have some other Rangers. Choose which Rangers you want to use for combining.
properties.TUTORIAL_LEVELUP0_STEP18_TXT: Alright then, tap the Level Up button and you'll do just that. Remember though, the Rangers you use for the combination will disappear!
properties.TUTORIAL_LEVELUP0_STEP19_TXT: Well, it *looks* like he's getting stronger...
properties.TUTORIAL_LEVELUP0_STEP2_TXT: Uuuugh... Don't say any more about it. It looks like the Alien army's getting gradually stronger and stronger.
properties.TUTORIAL_LEVELUP0_STEP20_TXT: I think his overall stats have gone up too!
properties.TUTORIAL_LEVELUP0_STEP21_TXT: Phew, thank goodness! Now we won't have any trouble no matter how powerful those Aliens are!
properties.TUTORIAL_LEVELUP0_STEP23_TXT: Alright, let's move on to the next stage.
properties.TUTORIAL_LEVELUP0_STEP3_TXT: Doctor, we need some new countermeasures. Got any ideas?
properties.TUTORIAL_LEVELUP0_STEP4_TXT: Oh, well that's easy. You guys just need to power up too.
properties.TUTORIAL_LEVELUP0_STEP5_TXT: Ah, that's brilliant! Why didn't I think of that?
properties.TUTORIAL_LEVELUP0_STEP6_TXT: Well that's because you don't know how.
properties.TUTORIAL_LEVELUP0_STEP7_TXT: ...Doctor, could you be a bit more specific as to how we can do that?
properties.TUTORIAL_LEVELUP0_STEP8_TXT: There are several ways to power yourselves up. For now, I'll just teach you how to beef up your bodies by leveling up.
properties.TUTORIAL_LEVELUP0_STEP9_TXT: Would there be any ways to beef up my beauty too?
properties.TUTORIAL_LEVELUP1_STEP1_TXT: Doctor, look at this. We got a new Ranger, but he looks like he could be my twin!
properties.TUTORIAL_LEVELUP1_STEP10_TXT: Where was I? Ah yes, now I'll teach you how to raise your level caps.
properties.TUTORIAL_LEVELUP1_STEP12_TXT: It's pretty similar to when you normally level up. You just have to select the same "twin" Rangers to combine as the Ranger you want to level up.
properties.TUTORIAL_LEVELUP1_STEP13_TXT: Now, combine your twin, uh, I mean, your new Ranger.
properties.TUTORIAL_LEVELUP1_STEP16_TXT: I'm not sure, but it feels like he's got even more potential now.
properties.TUTORIAL_LEVELUP1_STEP17_TXT: Indeed, you've raised your level cap. This is how you can raise your maximum power levels.
properties.TUTORIAL_LEVELUP1_STEP18_TXT: You have to work to make sure the Rangers who join you later don't overtake you!
properties.TUTORIAL_LEVELUP1_STEP20_TXT: Exactly! It's vital that you keep that drive to keep becoming more powerful.
properties.TUTORIAL_LEVELUP1_STEP21_TXT: You'll no doubt face new, unknown dangers out there. You must train your hardest to be ready for whatever they may be!
properties.TUTORIAL_LEVELUP1_STEP22_TXT: Let's roll out, with the wind flowing in our hair!
properties.TUTORIAL_LEVELUP1_STEP23_TXT: Okay, let's head to the next stage and look for Sally.
properties.TUTORIAL_LEVELUP1_STEP3_TXT: Ho-ho, this is good timing. This time, I'll teach you all about raising your level caps.
properties.TUTORIAL_LEVELUP1_STEP5_TXT: Well, you have limits to how far you can level up, and you can't go over those limits. Once you reach those limits, you can't get any stronger.
properties.TUTORIAL_LEVELUP1_STEP6_TXT: Yeah, I thought so... I had a feeling that I reached my max.
properties.TUTORIAL_LEVELUP1_STEP7_TXT: Really? I don't think you've reached your maximum level yet...
properties.TUTORIAL_LEVELUP1_STEP8_TXT: Whoops, ah, yeah, heh-heh, I guess I haven't!
properties.TUTORIAL_LEVELUP1_STEP9_TXT: Moon, stop fidgeting! Doctor, please hurry up and continue.
properties.TUTORIAL_NORMAL_STAGE_AUTO_PLAY_STEP1_TX: A new Auto-Advance feature has been added.
properties.TUTORIAL_NORMAL_STAGE_AUTO_PLAY_STEP2_TX: The Auto-Advance feature automatically clears new stages for you.
properties.TUTORIAL_NORMAL_STAGE_AUTO_PLAY_STEP3_TX: When using Auto-Advance you won't be able to use items or Friends features.
properties.TUTORIAL_NORMAL_STAGE_AUTO_PLAY_STEP4_TX: Please note that Auto-Advance may stop if you run out of Feathers, fail, or due to some other conditions.
properties.TUTORIAL_NORMAL_STAGE_AUTO_PLAY_STEP5_TX: The newly added features make it even more convenient to enjoy main stages!
properties.TUTORIAL_PASS_STEP1_TXT: Get lots of extra rewards with Rangers Passes!
properties.TUTORIAL_PASS_STEP2_TXT: Get Rangers Pass Points and reach the required Pass Levels to get extra rewards!
properties.TUTORIAL_PASS_STEP3_TXT: You can also get Tower Skins by activating a Rangers Pass and raising its level.
properties.TUTORIAL_PASS_STEP4_TXT: You can get Bonus Random Chests after reaching the final level.
properties.TUTORIAL_PASS_STEP5_TXT: You can get Rangers Pass Points by clearing Daily, Weekly, and Special Missions.
properties.TUTORIAL_PITY_MILEAGE_10: Every time you use Rubies and Gacha Tickets and play gachas, you'll get Mileage Points!
properties.TUTORIAL_PITY_MILEAGE_11: Use Mileage Points to get various rewards like Gacha Tickets.
properties.TUTORIAL_PITY_MILEAGE_12: Get stronger Rangers and Gear items!
properties.TUTORIAL_PITY_MILEAGE_2: Use Rubies and Gacha Tickets to get Rangers and become even stronger!
properties.TUTORIAL_PITY_MILEAGE_3: In the case of Rangers, whenever you play the Ultra Rare and Selection Gachas
properties.TUTORIAL_PITY_MILEAGE_4: the ceiling gauge will go up.
properties.TUTORIAL_PITY_MILEAGE_5: Want to learn about the Gear Gacha?
properties.TUTORIAL_PITY_MILEAGE_6: Gear items can only be obtained with Rubies,
properties.TUTORIAL_PITY_MILEAGE_7: and you can fill up the Gear gauge by playing the Special Gear Gacha!
properties.TUTORIAL_PITY_MILEAGE_8: You can get rewards when the gauge reaches different levels.
properties.TUTORIAL_PITY_MILEAGE_9: You can see a list of the rewards you can get here!
properties.TUTORIAL_PVP_ELEMENTAL_STEP1_TXT: There have been some new changes in PVP. It looks like PVP will have new rules this season! Powerful elemental effects are occurring throughout the stages.
properties.TUTORIAL_PVP_ELEMENTAL_STEP2_TXT: Rangers of the same element as the target area will receive a significant buff, while those with different elements will get a debuff. Be careful when you make your teams!
properties.TUTORIAL_PVP_ELEMENTAL_STEP3_TXT: Tap the "?" icon for details. Don't forget that elements are crucial this time. See you later!
properties.TUTORIAL_PVP_ELEMENTAL_STEP4_TXT: Aim for the top of this season's rankings!
properties.TUTORIAL_PVP_GUARDIAN_SELECT_GUIDE: A guild guardian will help you in PVP! Make a choice and go for it!
properties.TUTORIAL_REPEAT_BATTLE_ENTRY_1: Now you can use the repeat play and multiplier play features!
properties.TUTORIAL_REPEAT_BATTLE_ENTRY_2: Choose the number of times you want to play with the repeat play feature and you'll be able to repeat battles as much as you like.
properties.TUTORIAL_REPEAT_BATTLE_ENTRY_3: Use lots of Feathers at once with the multiplier feature to get rewards based on how many you used!
properties.TUTORIAL_REPEAT_BATTLE_ENTRY_4: Please note that you can't use items, friend features, or continue on battles with the multiplier play feature.
properties.TUTORIAL_REPEAT_BATTLE_ENTRY_5: The newly added features make it even more convenient to enjoy main stages!
properties.TUTORIAL_REPEAT_BATTLECLEAR_1: A play again feature has been added! You can now play the same stage again right after you've cleared it.
properties.TUTORIAL_REPEAT_BATTLECLEAR_2: You can also move to the next stage faster than usual by using the new shortcut feature!
properties.TUTORIAL_SEVENDAYS_QUEST_0_STEP01: I see you've been putting in a good effort. I have new missions for you today.
properties.TUTORIAL_SEVENDAYS_QUEST_0_STEP03: Yes, but you are full-fledged adventurers so you will be fine.
properties.TUTORIAL_SEVENDAYS_QUEST_0_STEP05: Ha! Don't worry. You will be properly compensated for taking on this new responsibility.
properties.TUTORIAL_SEVENDAYS_QUEST_0_STEP07: Tap the 7 Days icon over on the right side.
properties.TUTORIAL_SEVENDAYS_QUEST_1_STEP01: You can see your missions here.
properties.TUTORIAL_SEVENDAYS_QUEST_1_STEP02: You can handle these missions at your current level, so don't worry.
properties.TUTORIAL_SEVENDAYS_QUEST_1_STEP03: You can see details by tapping the help button. Do your best!
properties.TUTORIAL_SPACE_TRAIN_BATTLE_STEP1_TXT: You can alternate between using two lanes on Space Trains.
properties.TUTORIAL_SPACE_TRAIN_BATTLE_STEP2_TXT: Try changing the lane your Ranger runs on by tapping the other lane or the screen.
properties.TUTORIAL_SPACE_TRAIN_BATTLE_STEP3_TXT: You can also swap the running Ranger with a waiting Ranger. Aim for higher scores by making appropriate swaps based on the situation!
properties.TUTORIAL_SPACE_TRAIN_MAIN_STEP1_TXT: Wait! An SOS signal is coming from across the universe! Should we check it out?
properties.TUTORIAL_SPACE_TRAIN_STEP2_TXT: To save the Space Station, you must hop aboard various Space Trains and defeat the enemy while avoiding obstacles!
properties.TUTORIAL_SPACE_TRAIN_STEP3_TXT: You can play stages using Train Tickets. Train Tickets recharge regularly after a certain amount of time, so check back often!
properties.TUTORIAL_SPACE_TRAIN_STEP4_TXT: Play Space Train to collect points for stage rewards in order to unlock stages!
properties.TUTORIAL_SPACE_TRAIN_STEP5_TXT: Compete with other players using the highest scores you’ve got on each stage!
properties.TUTORIAL_SPECIAL_STAGE_AUTO_PLAY_STEP1_T: A new Auto-Advance feature has been added.
properties.TUTORIAL_SPECIAL_STAGE_AUTO_PLAY_STEP2_T: The Auto-Advance feature lets you automatically keep on battling on this planet’s stages.
properties.TUTORIAL_SPECIAL_STAGE_AUTO_PLAY_STEP3_T: When using Auto-Advance you won't be able to use items or Friends features.
properties.TUTORIAL_SPECIAL_STAGE_AUTO_PLAY_STEP4_T: With the Auto-Advance feature turned on, you’ll advance to the next step after a 3-second countdown and continue automatically until the final Boss Stage.
properties.TUTORIAL_SPECIAL_STAGE_AUTO_PLAY_STEP5_T: Please note that Auto-Advance may stop if you run out of Feathers, fail, or due to some other conditions.
properties.TUTORIAL_SPECIAL0_STEP1_TXT: Hey everyone, over here. I've got something to show you.
properties.TUTORIAL_SPECIAL0_STEP10_TXT: Well, no, they're not those kind of rewards, James.
properties.TUTORIAL_SPECIAL0_STEP11_TXT: Doctor, you can just ignore James.
properties.TUTORIAL_SPECIAL0_STEP12_TXT: Ah, then I shall. Let's check the Missions and roll out!
properties.TUTORIAL_SPECIAL0_STEP3_TXT: I've got some new Missions for novice adventurers like yourselves.
properties.TUTORIAL_SPECIAL0_STEP4_TXT: Well we kinda have our hands full just looking for Sally right now...
properties.TUTORIAL_SPECIAL0_STEP5_TXT: Oh, it's nothing to worry about. You'll be glad you took on these tasks!
properties.TUTORIAL_SPECIAL0_STEP6_TXT: What kind of things do we have to do?
properties.TUTORIAL_SPECIAL0_STEP7_TXT: See this? Here's where I put all the Missions I have for you. When you fulfill the conditions for that Mission, it will be immediately counted as complete.
properties.TUTORIAL_SPECIAL0_STEP8_TXT: And naturally, I'll give you rewards for every job you complete. You'll find my rewards very useful when it comes to powering yourselves up...
properties.TUTORIAL_SPECIAL0_STEP9_TXT: Oh, so I can take my good looks to even greater heights...
properties.TUTORIAL_START_END: Nice job! You've still got a ways to go, but it looks like you're ready to go out and save Sally for real! Here's Underwear Brown and Pink Ribbon Pico for all of your hard work!
properties.TUTORIAL_START_GEAR_TEXT: Did you know that gear can make your Rangers more powerful? Try getting an gear from the Gacha?
properties.TUTORIAL_START_STEP1_TXT: Arrrgh! Doctor Leonard! Something terrible's happened!
properties.TUTORIAL_START_STEP10_TXT: Um... Ya know, I hadn't really thought that far ahead yet.
properties.TUTORIAL_START_STEP11_TXT: Then don't worry, I'll teach you, bit by bit.
properties.TUTORIAL_START_STEP12_TXT: Come on, to the training room!
properties.TUTORIAL_START_STEP13_TXT: Come on, to the training room!
properties.TUTORIAL_START_STEP2_TXT: Oh, it's you, Moon. Your face is as white as a sheet. Calm down and tell me in detail what happened.
properties.TUTORIAL_START_STEP3_TXT: Well, I was out walking with Sally, and I slowed my pace down to match Sally's because she has such stubby little legs...
properties.TUTORIAL_START_STEP4_TXT: There was a nice breeze, and we were humming along and...
properties.TUTORIAL_START_STEP5_TXT: Alright, hold up a minute! I don't need that much detail! Just get to the "terrible" part!
properties.TUTORIAL_START_STEP6_TXT: Uh, right... It's Sally... She... An army of Aliens kidnapped her!
properties.TUTORIAL_START_STEP7_TXT: What?! That *is* terrible news! We have to go after her now!
properties.TUTORIAL_START_STEP8_TXT: Yes, Doc! I'll go after her right now!
properties.TUTORIAL_START_STEP9_TXT: Wait a minute there! How are you going to fight the Alien army?
properties.TUTORIAL_SUPER_LEONARD_STEP01_TXT: So, you got a Super Leonard then.
properties.TUTORIAL_SUPER_LEONARD_STEP03_TXT: Do you remember how to raise yourselves to maximum level?
properties.TUTORIAL_SUPER_LEONARD_STEP04_TXT: We combine the same Rangers together?
properties.TUTORIAL_SUPER_LEONARD_STEP05_TXT: Exactly! But Super Leonards like this can raise the maximum level of *other* Rangers.
properties.TUTORIAL_SUPER_LEONARD_STEP06_TXT: Wow! If we don't need to be the same Ranger to use them, I'd like to use this one first!
properties.TUTORIAL_SUPER_LEONARD_STEP07_TXT: Calm down, you'll get more Super Leonards in your coming adventures!
properties.TUTORIAL_TALENT_RANGERS_2: You can unlock Talents <#ffe53d>1 level at a time<-> by combining the <#ffe53d>same Rangers<->, <#ffe53d>Rangers at the same stage of evolution<->, or <#ffe53d>Talent Leonards<->.
properties.TUTORIAL_TALENT_RANGERS_3: There are 2 types of unlockable Talents. There are <#ffe53d>main Talents<-> that give <#ffe53d>special powers<->, and <#ffe53d>enhance Talents<-> that <#ffe53d>raise stats.<->
properties.TUTORIAL_TALENT_RANGERS_4: In particular, main Talents will reveal very powerful effects at Level 1.
properties.TUTORIAL_TALENT_RANGERS_5: Unlocked Talents are displayed like this. Nothing will display if no Talents have been unlocked, or there are no Talents.
properties.TUTORIAL_TALENT_RANGERS_6: Each Ranger can have their own unique Talent effects, so be sure to check their Talents out!
properties.TUTORIAL_TEAM_SETTING_TEXT_2: Your Team has 5 Rangers in it.
properties.TUTORIAL_TEAM_SETTING_TEXT_3: Swipe to arrange your Team or remove Rangers from your Team.
properties.TUTORIAL_TEAM_SETTING_TEXT_4: First, take a Ranger on your team and drag to remove it.
properties.TUTORIAL_TEAM_SETTING_TEXT_5: Good! Now drag a Ranger to add it to the team.
properties.TUTORIAL_TEAM_SETTING_TEXT3: Hm? You got something else you wanted to say?
properties.TUTORIAL_TEAM_SETTING_TEXT5: Not really, it's just that... "Our" hair? You don't have any!
properties.TUTORIAL_TEAM_SLOT_SETTING_2: Set up Team A and Team B to use both teams in the battle!
properties.TUTORIAL_TEAM_TOWER_SKIN: Change your Tower Skins here! Get Tower Skins and apply them to your Tower!
properties.TUTORIAL_TEAMSET0_STEP15_TXT: Alright! Now my Team's perfect! I ain't afraid of no stinky Alien force now!
properties.TUTORIAL_TEAMSET0_STEP16_TXT: Then let's head out and rescue Sally.
properties.TUTORIAL_TEAMSET0_STEP17_TXT: Yeah! Let's roll out, with the wind flowing through our hair!
properties.TUTORIAL_TEAMSET0_STEP19_TXT: Hm? You got something else you wanted to say?
properties.TUTORIAL_TEAMSET0_STEP20_TXT: Not really, it's just that... "Our" hair? You don't have any!
properties.TUTORIAL_TEAMSET1_STEP1_TXT: So is there one Element that's stronger and one that's weaker than all the others?
properties.TUTORIAL_TEAMSET1_STEP2_TXT: No, it really depends on the relationship between your Elements and the Elements of your opponents.
properties.TUTORIAL_TEAMSET1_STEP3_TXT: Fire's weak to Water, but strong against Wood. Quite the expert, aren't you, James?
properties.TUTORIAL_TEAMSET1_STEP4_TXT: Ah-hem! That's because my knowledge rivals only how handsome I am...
properties.TUTORIAL_TEAMSET1_STEP6_TXT: Well then, let's add your new Rangers to your Team.
properties.TUTORIAL_TREASURE0_STEP1_TXT: Hey everyone, look at this. What do you think it is?
properties.TUTORIAL_TREASURE0_STEP10_TXT: Why don't we hear more about them while we look them over? Let's go to the treasure chests now.
properties.TUTORIAL_TREASURE0_STEP11_TXT: There's a treasure chest over there. Let's go check it out!
properties.TUTORIAL_TREASURE0_STEP13_TXT: This place holds the power of the ancients. Here, you can gain powers that will help you rescue Sally.
properties.TUTORIAL_TREASURE0_STEP14_TXT: Alright! With these powers, we can rescue Sally in no time!
properties.TUTORIAL_TREASURE0_STEP15_TXT: With that said... How do we use these powers?
properties.TUTORIAL_TREASURE0_STEP16_TXT: You can't, not yet anyway. They're sealed away, and you'll have to break those seals.
properties.TUTORIAL_TREASURE0_STEP17_TXT: So how do we do that?
properties.TUTORIAL_TREASURE0_STEP18_TXT: You'll need to collect 3 treasures to break a seal. The treasure you brought me earlier is 1 of them.
properties.TUTORIAL_TREASURE0_STEP19_TXT: If you're lucky, you'll come across more treasures as you search for Sally.
properties.TUTORIAL_TREASURE0_STEP2_TXT: Let's take it to Dr. Leonard for him to look at.
properties.TUTORIAL_TREASURE0_STEP20_TXT: The hidden locations of these treasures are carved into this wall painting, so when you need some, keep an eye out!
properties.TUTORIAL_TREASURE0_STEP21_TXT: Treasures, huh? Whatever it is, I hope it compliments my good looks!
properties.TUTORIAL_TREASURE0_STEP22_TXT: ... Ooookaaaaay, Sally's counting on us, so let's get out there!
properties.TUTORIAL_TREASURE0_STEP3_TXT: Doctor! Could you have a look at this?
properties.TUTORIAL_TREASURE0_STEP4_TXT: Hm? What have you got for me this time, Moon?
properties.TUTORIAL_TREASURE0_STEP5_TXT: Let's see... Ah, this is an ancient treasure.
properties.TUTORIAL_TREASURE0_STEP7_TXT: Yes indeedy, there are treasures all over the place containing the power of this world's ancient ones within.
properties.TUTORIAL_TREASURE0_STEP8_TXT: Treasures that hold the power of the ancient ones! Pretty cool, right, Brown?
